officialEvidence.claim: The direct Claude API supports API keys and workload identity federation for production workloads.
Claude API workspaces scope keys, roles, rate limits, spend limits, and usage reporting.
Claude organization access can be integrated with enterprise single sign-on and JIT or SCIM provisioning.
Claude Enterprise has member spend limits that are separate from Claude API workspace limits.
Claude in Amazon Bedrock uses AWS-native authentication, billing, and AWS-managed security boundaries.
Claude on Google Cloud offers global, multi-region, and regional endpoints with different residency and availability tradeoffs.
Microsoft Foundry provides Azure-native endpoints and authentication, Azure Marketplace billing, and Azure-hosted or Anthropic-hosted deployment choices.
